meta.title: Chappie — Hands-free voice AI assistant for Mac
meta.description: A hands-free voice AI assistant that lives in your menu bar. Just say "chappie" — the rest is voice only. Windows version coming soon.
meta.ogLead: A hands-free voice AI assistant that lives in your menu bar.

hero.title: Chappie
hero.lead: A hands-free voice AI assistant that lives in your menu bar. No keyboard, no mouse — just talk.
hero.footnote: Mac (Apple Silicon) · Windows version coming soon · Open source · Indie made

capabilities.heading: Things you can say.
capabilities.lead: Wake it with "chappie", then just keep talking.
capabilities.allHeading: The full list of things you can say.
capabilities.allLead: Every voice command Chappie understands today, in one place.

chat.title: Chat with you
chat.example2: "How do I say 'good job' in Japanese?"
chat.body: Casual chat to thoughtful conversations. Chappie remembers the recent flow, so "about that thing we just talked about" works.

timer.title: Set timers
timer.body: Just say the duration. Chappie tells you when time is up. Multiple timers at once, remaining time check, cancel — all by voice.

reminder.title: Schedule reminders
reminder.example2: "Remind me about my meds at 8 PM"
reminder.body: Absolute-time reminders like "7 AM tomorrow" or "8 PM". Reminders survive an app restart, so morning wake-ups still fire.

time.title: Tell time & dates
time.body: Reads your Mac's clock. Math like "how many hours until 6 PM?" works too.

weather.title: Tell the weather
weather.body: Skip the location and Chappie defaults to your area; name a city and you get that one instead. Current temp, plus today and tomorrow's highs, lows, and chance of rain.

calendar.title: Read your schedule
calendar.body: Reads from your Mac's Calendar (read-only). Today, tomorrow, or the next 7 days — Chappie picks up titles, times, and locations and reads them out loud.

web.title: Open websites & search
web.body: Launches your default browser to open a URL or run a web search. Great for kicking off research when your hands are full.

volume.title: Control system volume
volume.body: Adjusts macOS output volume by voice. Absolute levels and relative "a bit louder / quieter" both work — perfect when your hands are full.

apps.title: Launch apps & open folders
apps.body: Launches any installed Mac app by name. Also opens Finder at common folders (Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Applications, Trash, etc.) by voice — the menu bar becomes your voice launcher.

lock.title: Lock, sleep & stay-awake
lock.body: Lock, display-off, or sleep with one word. Or flip it — "stay awake" prevents sleep during long-running tasks (timed or open-ended).

battery.title: Check the battery
battery.body: Percent, charging state, and time remaining in one answer — handy for "can I make it through this meeting?" calls without flipping to the menu bar.

notes.title: Take voice notes
notes.body: Capture quick thoughts by voice. Ask later — "find the X note" — and Chappie pulls just the matching ones. They stick around even after you quit the app.

memory.title: Remembers you across sessions
memory.body: Name, family, role, preferences — Chappie quietly picks them up from everyday conversation and carries them forward to the next session. No need to say "remember this" every time, no need to reintroduce yourself. Say "forget that" anytime to drop a memory.

music.title: Control your music
music.body: Voice control for whichever of Spotify or Apple Music is already running. Play / pause / skip, plus "what song is this?" gets you the title and artist.

clipboard.title: Read & write the clipboard
clipboard.example3: "Write a short thank-you email and copy it"
clipboard.body: Reads aloud what's on your clipboard, or drops the text Chappie just produced into it so you can paste straight into the next app.

screenshot.title: Take a screenshot
screenshot.body: Selection or full screen, all by voice. The image goes straight to your clipboard so you can paste into the next app — or save it as a PNG on the Desktop.

goodbye.title: Politely goes back to standby
goodbye.body: Chappie picks up on goodbyes by itself and quietly returns to standby. No button to press — just say the next "chappie" when you need it again.

menubar.headingLine1: Always tucked into the menu bar.
menubar.headingLine2: Shows up only when you need it.
menubar.body: No Dock icon, no window. Stays quietly in standby until you call.

features.heading: An assistant that blends into your day
features.lead: Just the right distance — visible when needed, invisible when not.

wake.title: Just say "chappie"
wake.body: No hotkeys, no clicks. Wake it with your voice, then keep talking naturally.

local.title: Voice stays local
local.body: Speech is transcribed entirely on your Mac. The raw audio never leaves the device.

memory.title: Remembers what matters
memory.body: Within a session: keeps the last 20 turns so "about what we just said" continues naturally. Across sessions: quietly picks up names, preferences, and other durable facts so you don't reintroduce yourself every time.

menubar.title: Menu bar resident, no Dock clutter
menubar.body: The app is just a menu bar icon. Settings open only when you need them.

languages.title: Speaks 9 languages
languages.body: Japanese, English, plus Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese (Beta). Pick one and Chappie automatically uses a matching macOS system voice.

update.title: Auto-update
update.body: Checks at launch and quietly every 6 hours. New versions show a tray badge so you can update on your time.

states.heading: Status shows on Chappie's face in the menu bar.

idle.label: Idle
idle.body: Waiting quietly for you to say "chappie".

listening.label: Listening
listening.body: Tuned in and capturing what you're saying.

privacy.heading: Your voice stays on your Mac
privacy.body: What the mic picks up is converted to text right on your Mac. The recording itself never goes to the internet. Only the text version of your question is sent to an AI service to think up a reply.
privacy.note: * Requires an API key from one of OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic.

finalCta.heading: Try saying hello.
finalCta.lead: Download, then look at the Chappie icon in your menu bar and say "chappie".
